findings.reader: A disciplined, well-bounded news explainer: it answers the dated dispute first, makes the teacher-output/student-learning mechanism concrete, keeps the analogy honest about its limits, preserves the allegation/denial/missing-evidence structure at every layer (headline, story, cocktail summary, class note), and leaves the reader with a genuinely reusable provenance question. No failure families detected; comprehension and transfer both verified.
findings.facts: Factually sound dated news piece: every material claim (advisory date, six named companies, quantities, government-awareness caveat, China's denial and monopoly counter-charge, AP's four-company non-response, agency recommendations) matches the supplied CISA, MOFCOM and AP excerpts, with allegation/denial attribution and the missing-public-evidence limit consistently preserved.
